# Content a human never personally vetted,
# flowing straight into the model's context:
#
#   RAG pipeline      -> document chunks
#   Browsing agent     -> a fetched web page
#   Email assistant     -> an inbox message
#   Coding assistant   -> repo comments / README
#
# Each one carries the model's full attention,
# same as a developer instruction would.
caption: Any of these is a delivery channel that never has to trick a single person.
